title: Let `engram task-sync sync` exchange project memories on a branch that holds them
outcome: Let `engram task-sync sync` exchange project memories on a branch that holds them
acceptance: `engram task-sync sync` on a data branch that holds project memories exports, merges, imports and publishes the memories together with the tasks, with the same fast-forward, divergent-merge, stop and retry behaviour it has for tasks

Behaviour tests run sync between two stores on a memory-carrying branch and observe a memory added or revised on each side arriving on the other, plus a conflicting memory edit stopping before publication
The docs and the engram-use skill no longer send memory-carrying branches to the explicit export and import commands
